verification.title: Doctor Identity & Registration Verification
verification.description: Verify your National Medical Commission (NMC) registration and confirm your identity via live facial biometric match.

doctorDetails.title: NMC Registration Details
doctorDetails.description: Enter your professional details as registered with the National Medical Commission (NMC).
doctorDetails.name: Doctor Full Name
doctorDetails.medicalCouncilPlaceholder: Select or type your registered council
doctorDetails.sandboxNotice: Sandbox Mode Active: Use test credential 'Priyansh V Shah', Reg '48217', Council 'SANDBOX TEST COUNCIL' for demo testing.

idDocument.title: Government Identity Document
idDocument.description: Upload a clear government ID or medical registration certificate containing your photo.
idDocument.uploadPrompt: Click or drag & drop ID document (JPEG/PNG, max 10MB)
idDocument.noFaceFound: No face found in the document. Please upload a clear photo ID.
idDocument.privacyNotice: Privacy Guaranteed: Uploaded ID documents and face embeddings are purged from memory immediately upon completion.

liveness.title: Live Blink & Liveness Detection
liveness.description: Position your face inside the frame. Blink naturally when instructed to prove liveness.
liveness.instruction: Look directly at the camera and blink naturally
liveness.livenessFailed: Liveness check failed. Please try again.
liveness.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Please allow camera permissions in your browser.

faceMatch.title: FaceNet Biometric Verification
faceMatch.description: Running on-device FaceNet inference to match ID document photo with live camera snapshot.
faceMatch.noMatch: Biometric match failed. Faces do not match.

outcome.successSubtitle: Your identity and professional registration have been verified.
outcome.failedSubtitle: We could not verify your identity or registration details.
outcome.sandboxDisclaimer: This is a demonstration result and is not an NMC registry result.

nmc.unavailable: Verification isn't available right now. Please try again later.
nmc.notFound: Registration record not found in NMC register. Please check details.

errors.requiredFields: Please fill in all required fields.
errors.uploadDocument: Please upload an ID document first.
errors.livenessFailed: Liveness check could not be completed.
errors.faceMismatch: Facial comparison did not meet threshold.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred during verification.
